question: How much does a golf simulator cost per hour in the Twin Cities?
answer: At The Links, a bay is $45 an hour off-peak (Monday to Friday 8am-5pm, and Sunday from 5pm to close) and $60 an hour at peak (weekday evenings, all day Saturday, and Sunday 8am-5pm) - and that is per bay, not per person. Up to six people can share one bay for the same price, which usually works out cheaper per head than a round outdoors.
